name: Nutanix
summary:
Nutanix provides hybrid multicloud infrastructure and platform technologies that help organisations modernise, simplify, and operate enterprise infrastructure environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Nutanix environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure platforms. From virtualisation and infrastructure modernisation through to Kubernetes operations and platform resilience, we help teams create scalable, reliable, and operationally consistent environments.
overview:
Nutanix technologies support modern enterprise infrastructure through hybrid multicloud, virtualisation, storage, and cloud-native platform capabilities.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Nutanix environments across enterprise, hybrid, and cloud infrastructure. From hyperconverged infrastructure and virtualisation through to Kubernetes platforms and operational governance, we help teams create environments that are secure, scalable, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building modern infrastructure foundations that support long-term operational resilience and platform scalability. This includes infrastructure automation, observability, lifecycle management, platform security, operational enablement, and infrastructure modernisation across complex enterprise environments.

We help organisations reduce operational complexity, improve infrastructure efficiency, and deliver modern platform environments with confidence.
